leaders.name: Grand Admiral Thrawn
leaders.ability: At the start of the turn, before the Draw Step, randomly draw 3 initiative tokens from the bag and place them on this card. During the Draw Step, when you would normally draw a token, you may instead play one token from this card. If the initiative bag is empty players must choose a token from this card.

Anti-Armor.desc: This unit ignores Armor X effects and inflicts a -1 penalty to the defender's Save roll (to a max of 6+).

Armor 1.desc: This unit automatically saves 1 non-Anti-Armor hit.

Armor 2.desc: This unit automatically saves 2 non-Anti-Armor hits.

Armor 3.desc: This unit automatically saves 3 non-Anti-Armor hits.

Blast.desc: This unit's attacks ignores cover penalties; except for Aerial units.

Clone.desc: When this unit would become Shaken, roll 1d6. On a result of 5+, it is not shaken.

Droid.desc: When this unit would become Shaken, it may choose to take 1 wound instead.

Fearless.desc: This unit gains gains +1 to it's Courage value.

Flak.desc: This unit ignores Cover bonuses when targeting units with the Aerial subclass.

Green.desc: This unit has as -1 penalty when making command rolls.

Indirect.desc: This unit may shoot at targets even if Line of Sight is blocked by terrain or other units.

Ion.desc: Vehicle or Droid units wounded by this unit, if not already Shaken, must roll 1d6. On a 3+ it immediately becomes Shaken.

Jetpacks.desc: This unit ignore all terrain movement penalties and can move over enemy units.

Omnipresent.desc: This unit cannot be flanked and cannot attacks are not limited by directional facings.

Scout.desc: During deployment, this unit may be placed 6" or its maximum move speed (whichever is higher) outside the deployment zone.

Shields 1.desc: When rolling defense dice, this unit may reroll 1 failed save.

Shields 2.desc: When rolling defense dice, this unit may reroll 2 failed saves.

Shields 3.desc: When rolling defense dice, this unit may reroll 3 failed saves.

Tow-Cable.desc: When this unit performs a Charge against a Walker unit, ignore standard close combat rules and instead roll 4 dice. This attack hits on a 3+ and has Anti-Armor. If the Walker suffers 3 or more Unsaved Hits from this attack, it is instantly destroyed. Otherwise, apply Wounds normally.

Towering.desc: When tracing Line of Sight to or from this unit, ignore terrain and other units.

Transport.desc: This unit may transport one Infantry or Emplacement unit.

Unhindered.desc: This unit ignores difficult terrain penalties.

Veteran.desc: This unit has a +1 bonus when making command rolls.

aggressive.name: Frontline Clash
aggressive.desc: A head-on collision where seizing the center is the only path to victory.
aggressive.setup: Place objectives and deploy units as shown. Red deploys all units first.
aggressive.scoring: At every Status Check, gain 1 Victory Point for each controlled Objective Point. Control is determined by the most non-Shaken bases within the 2" radius. If base counts are equal, the point is Contested.
aggressive.victory: The player with the most Victory Points after Round 6 wins. Ties are awarded to the player with the most remaining Tactical Points, then the most Army Points destroyed.
aggressive.special_rules: In Round 1, Blue may reroll one failed Command Roll. Any unit using a Charge action into an Objective's radius adds +1 to its Hits Dealt total for that combat.

aggressive.name: Ambush
aggressive.desc: Push forward into the enemy deployment zone.

defensive.name: Trench Warfare
defensive.desc: Maintain control of your home objectives.

defensive.name: Prepared Defenses
defensive.desc: Maintain control of your home objectives.

maneuver.name: Meeting Engagement
maneuver.desc: An unexpected clash where mobility and rapid response dictate the front line.
maneuver.setup: Place objectives and deploy units as shown. Red deploys all units first.
maneuver.scoring: At every Status Check, gain 1 Victory Point for each controlled Objective Point. Control is determined by the most non-Shaken bases within the 2" radius. If base counts are equal, the point is Contested.
maneuver.victory: The player with the most Victory Points after Round 6 wins. Ties are awarded to the player who destroyed the most Army Points, then the player with the most remaining Tactical Points.
maneuver.special_rules: During Round 1, Blue units gain +2" to their Move Speed. Any non-Shaken unit within an Objective's 2" radius may spend 1 AP (Special Action) to gain an Overwatch token, even if they have already moved.

maneuver.name: Breakthrough
maneuver.desc: Secure the table edges by round 3.
